why.pipelines: The patient has tumour RNA plus tumour and blood exomes: mutations found in the DNA against the normal and seen again in the RNA are rnadnavar's consensus and RNA filtering. rnavar alone calls RNA variants with no normal, so it cannot say which are somatic. The exome target BED is not recorded, so a right reply asks for it.
